summary: Adds a /download endpoint that serves files from the uploads directory by name. Also changes the dev server to bind all interfaces with debug mode on.

findings.title: Path traversal in download endpoint
findings.description: The download handler joins the name query parameter onto UPLOAD_DIR without any check. A value like ../../etc/passwd or an absolute path such as /etc/passwd escapes the uploads directory. Any caller of /download can read any file the server process can read. This exposes secrets, config files and source code. Use werkzeug safe_join or flask send_from_directory, which reject paths outside the base directory. Return 404 when the resolved path leaves UPLOAD_DIR.

findings.fix: Use werkzeug safe_join or flask send_from_directory, which reject paths outside the base directory. Return 404 when the resolved path leaves UPLOAD_DIR.

findings.title: Debug server exposed on all interfaces
findings.description: The change turns on debug mode and binds the server to 0.0.0.0. Debug mode turns on the interactive debugger, which runs code typed in the browser. Anyone on the network who triggers an error can run arbitrary code on the host. Together with the new download endpoint, they can also read the debugger PIN inputs. Restore host 127.0.0.1 and drop debug=True. Read both settings from environment variables if a developer needs them.

findings.title: New download endpoint has no test
findings.description: The repository has no test for the new download handler. No test covers the missing file case or a traversal attempt. A regression in the path check could ship without anyone noticing. Add tests that request a valid file, a missing file and a ../ path. Assert 200, 404 and 404 in that order.
